description: Manage SBZ; balance and statements are free. Top-up/x402 spends money; use trade for item purchases. Prepare a free quote with credits, payer and an available payment_options route. Prove ownership by signing the returned challenge via continue step=wallet_proof for direct crypto payment; the signed x402 payment can supply proof instead. Approve the exact quote, network, expiry and terms. For ALGO, Algorand USDC or SIBIDZ, call x402 with operation_id, authority, terms and a fresh request_id, distinct from prepare. Retry identical arguments with _meta["x402/payment"]; uncertainty reuses that ID and payment. Credit follows confirmation. BTC and USDT (Ethereum/Tron) use direct payment; bank top-ups use prepare then approval. Returns account/operation state, billing or payment requirements.

accept_terms.description: True only after explicit approval of the returned financial terms. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

action.description: Choose the operation; supply only its applicable fields. read: read the selected projection; x402: request or submit the exact signed top-up payment; prepare: quote and freeze an operation without paying; confirm: execute the exact approved prepared authority; continue: complete only the named pending step; cancel: cancel an eligible pending operation; export: produce the authorised private export; fiat: use a supported national currency; fiat_sent: report that the approved bank payment was sent.

anyOf.description: Positive SBZ integer as a string. Your processed balance must cover principal plus the transfer fee.

amount.description: For prepare intent=transfer, a positive whole SBZ integer string. For action=fiat, a decimal amount in the selected payment method’s currency, e.g. "123" for 123 USD; at most two decimal places.

approve.description: True only after approving the prepared operation and its exact amount. true: explicitly approve the stated condition.

authority_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact prepared payment authority the person approved.

claim_id.description: Exact existing reward entitlement UUID. UUID.

credits.description: Positive whole SBZ amount to purchase; never an item price.

cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor from this exact query; omit for the first page.

customer_postal_code.description: Actual customer postal code when required.

customer_region.description: Actual customer country required for payment eligibility.

display_currency.description: Fiat display currency for indicative equivalents; native settlement remains unchanged.

fiat_cursor.description: Opaque next-page cursor for fiat payment activity.

financial_principal.description: Private financial principal. Country is required for payment checks. Individual representative defaults to legal_name; businesses must name one.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. individual: a natural person; business: an organisation with an authorised representative.

legal_name.description: Actual legal name supplied by the account owner.

representative.description: Named authorised representative of an organisation.

format.description: Requested export format. csv: comma-separated export; pdf: printable document export.

intent.description: Choose the financial operation to prepare; preparing alone does not pay. top_up: buy SBZ through the chosen exact payment route; return_original: return an eligible original payment to its recorded sender; transfer: transfer explicitly approved SBZ to a profile; evidence: request the selected private financial evidence; claim: claim an existing reward entitlement.

limit.description: Maximum page size; omit for the operation’s default. Default 12. Maximum 100.

max_fee.description: Approved immediate service fee ceiling as a whole SBZ string; separate from the item price.

max_network_fee.description: Explicit maximum network fee in the original asset’s units.

method.description: Choose the supported delivery, receiving or evidence method. thb_international: international bank transfer in Thai baht; thb_promptpay: Thai PromptPay transfer; gbp_international: international bank transfer in sterling; gbp_local: local UK sterling transfer; usd_international: international bank transfer in US dollars; usd_domestic: domestic US-dollar transfer.

month.description: Statement month in YYYY-MM form in the selected timezone.

operation_id.description: Exact prepared financial operation UUID; reuse it after uncertain payment. UUID.

payer_address.description: Exact paying wallet address on the selected network.

payment.description: Exact observed payment locator for reconciliation; never a new payment instruction.

event_index.description: Exact event index within the confirmed transaction.

kind.description: Select the record, decision or variant described by this container. transaction: one original network transaction.

principal_source.description: Explicitly acknowledge the complete private financial principal returned by inspect financial_principal, using its immutable agreement acceptance ID. If its country is missing, supply financial_principal with your country instead. UUID.

recipient_profile_id.description: Exact recipient profile for the explicitly approved SBZ transfer. UUID.

request_id.description: UUID for one logical request; reuse it with identical arguments after uncertainty. UUID.

route.description: Supported route identifiers, not availability. First read browse ref kind=payment_options; prepare only a route with available=true. btc: Bitcoin top-up; algo: Algorand ALGO top-up; usdc: Algorand USDC top-up; sibidz: native SIBIDZ top-up; usdt_ethereum: Ethereum USDT route, only when available; usdt_tron: TRON USDT route, only when available.

saleId.description: Exact sale identity returned by discovery or the conversation.

signature.description: Signature over the returned challenge; never a private key.

step.description: Select the exact pending setup or recovery step returned by the service. wallet_proof: prove control of the exact paying address; payment: record or reconcile the original payment.

terms_hash.description: SHA-256 of those exact financial terms.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for activity/statement boundaries; default UTC.

view.description: Select the account or credit projection to read. overview: processed balance and recent activity; statement: recorded credit movements; statements: monthly credit history.

name: credits

billing.description: charged, assessed, balance and available_credits are whole SBZ strings or null; receipt_id identifies the saved fee. Replays never charge twice.

committed_stages.description: Stages already committed before a later refusal; retain their receipts.

data.description: SBZ balance, statements, frozen operation authority, expiry, payment instructions and confirmed receipts. IDs are exact returned identifiers (UUID where declared); prices retain amount/currency (123 USD); times use ISO 8601 UTC; cursors are opaque.

error.description: Optional business error: code, message, HTTP status, retryable and recovery details.

next.description: Exactly one required continuation: call, input, approval, choice, wait or done. It never grants new consent.

pagination.description: Optional next-page call; not required work or consent.

retry.description: Optional exact request_id and permitted recovery call.

state.description: Outcome: finished, still processing, needs approval/input, or refused.

summary.description: Plain-language result, including a business error.

title: Manage credits and approved payments
